proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C A' B' C' hc hB hB' h1 h2
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hB
  obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hB'
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at h1 h2
  have m1 : (AffineMap.lineMap A' C' t' : P) -ᵥ (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {A' -ᵥ A} := by
    rw [h1]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have m2 : C' -ᵥ C ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {A' -ᵥ A} := by
    rw [h2]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m2
  have e1 : (AffineMap.lineMap A' C' t' : P) -ᵥ (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P) =
      t' • (C' -ᵥ A') - t • (C -ᵥ A) + (A' -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub]
    abel
  have e2 : C' -ᵥ C = (C' -ᵥ A') - (C -ᵥ A) + (A' -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C' C A, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel C' A' A]
    abel
  rw [e1] at hk
  rw [e2] at hl
  have hv : C' -ᵥ A' = l • (A' -ᵥ A) + (C -ᵥ A) - (A' -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [hl]; abel
  have hrel : (t' - t) • (C -ᵥ A) = (k - t' * l + t' - 1) • (A' -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [hv] at hk
    have : k • (A' -ᵥ A) - (t' * l - t' + 1) • (A' -ᵥ A) = (t' - t) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
      rw [hk]; module
    rw [← this]; module
  have htt : t' = t := by
    by_contra hne
    apply hc
    have hne' : t' - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
    have hu : C -ᵥ A = ((k - t' * l + t' - 1) / (t' - t)) • (A' -ᵥ A) := by
      rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← hrel, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne', one_smul]
    have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair ((k - t' * l + t' - 1) / (t' - t)) A A'
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hu, vsub_vadd] at h3
    have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
    rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
  subst htt
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right, dist_lineMap_right]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C A' B' C' : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, C, A'} : Set P) → B ∈ line[ℝ, A, C] → B' ∈ line[ℝ, A', C'] → (line[ℝ, A, A']).Parallel line[ℝ, B, B'] → (line[ℝ, A, A']).Parallel line[ℝ, C, C'] → dist A B * dist B' C' = dist B C * dist A' B'
